## Meeting Purpose

[Discuss progress, priorities, and future plans for the canteen management app development.](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=27.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [NFC card implementation is the top priority for improving canteen efficiency](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=685.0)
  - [App is providing value but needs refinement; aiming for full implementation by November 1st](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=992.0)
  - [Potential to expand app usage across other Kazaj locations and even to other companies](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=3472.0)
  - [Adrian invited to Kazaj Christmas party on December 13th for networking and live app demo](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=4039.0)

## Topics

### Current App Status and Improvements

  - [Copy functionality for weekly menu planning now available](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=1248.0)
  - [Automatic saving of meal selections implemented, removing need for manual save button](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=138.0)
  - [Language translations added to reports](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=2842.0)
  - [UI improvements made based on user feedback (e.g., showing soup details without selection)](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=2807.0)

### User Adoption and Challenges

  - [Some workers struggling with app usage, particularly those with language or tech barriers](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=2420.0)
  - [List of specific users having difficulties provided for targeted observation and improvement](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=2435.0)
  - [Video tutorial being created to assist with onboarding and usage](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=2038.0)

### Priority Features and Development

  - [NFC card system or equivalent quick control system is the top priority](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=685.0)
  - [Kitchen interface for batch processing orders needed](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=892.0)
  - [Aim to have a fully functional system by November 1st](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=859.0)
  - [Secondary priorities include company billing reports and UI refinements](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=656.0)

### Future Potential and Expansion

  - [Consideration of presenting the app to all Kazaj companies in January meeting](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=3472.0)
  - [Potential for expanding to other markets (Germany, Gibraltar, Angola)](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=3472.0)
  - [Possible applications in other industries (universities, hospitals)](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=3898.0)

### Financial Discussions

  - [Need to address monthly invoicing for ongoing development work](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=905.0)
  - [Suggestion of €2,000/month payment until reaching 400 users, then moving to user-based pricing](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=940.0)
  - [Importance of demonstrating value to justify ongoing payments](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=992.0)

## Next Steps

  - [Adrian to focus on completing NFC implementation and kitchen queue system](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=3987.0)
  - [Adrian to provide timeline estimate for NFC feature completion](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=3987.0)
  - [Filipe to follow up on invoice payment for installation work](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=3275.0)
  - [Adrian to consider attending Kazaj Christmas party on December 13th](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=4039.0)
  - [Continue refining app based on user feedback and usage data](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=2420.0)
  - [Explore potential for expanding app usage to other Kazaj locations](https://fathom.video/share/diHoAe3BVf6w5NaCgEB-pJyVNW_K7zPR?tab=summary&timestamp=3472.0)
